review_candidates.title: Lead Mainframe Storage Engineer
review_candidates.description: In the Technology division, we leverage innovation to build the connections and capabilities that power our Firm, enabling our clients and colleagues to redefine markets and shape the future of our communities. This is a Lead Cloud & Infrastructure Engineering position at Vice President Level, which is part of the job family responsible for managing and optimizing technical infrastructure and ensuring the seamless operation of IT systems to support business needs effectively. Morgan Stanley is an industry leader in financial services, known for mobilizing capital to help governments, corporations, institutions, and individuals around the world achieve their financial goals. Interested in joining a team that’s eager to create, innovate and make an impact on the world? Read on. Enterprise Z is dedicated to bolstering organizational stability, security and efficiency by leveraging IBM Z technology in alignment with Morgan Stanley’s tech goals. Through advanced observability, automation and modern architectural strategies, we deliver scalable, reliable and high-performing technology solutions. These solutions ensure seamless integration while providing exceptional value. Our unwavering commitment to innovation, collaboration and continuous improvement nurtures a resilient, forward-thinking organization capable of meeting the demanding needs of our clients and adhering to global standards. We are searching for a Lead Mainframe Storage Engineer to join the Z Infrastructure team responsible for providing a highly available Z Compute and Storage platform, resilient against infra failures, regional disasters and cyber events. What You’ll Do In The Role Infrastructure Management: Configure and maintain hardware including IBM DS8000 series DASD, TS7700 Virtual Tape Servers (VTS), that requires experience with the TS7700 MI and DS8K HMCs Data & Space Management: Utilize the DFSMS suite of products to design SMS configurations, manage data class, storage class, and management class rules. Backup & Disaster Recovery: Oversee data replication, disaster recovery planning, and routine backups, leveraging tools like DFHSM and DFDSS. Capacity Planning: Monitor storage utilization, forecast future space requirements, and plan infrastructure upgrades to prevent storage shortages. Automation & Scripting: Write and maintain automation scripts using REXX to streamline routine storage operations and alerts. For e.g. adding volumes to a storage group that is short on capacity. Incident Response: Troubleshoot storage-related outages, perform root cause analysis (RCA), and resolve dataset access issues. What You’ll Bring To The Role Operating Systems: Deep knowledge of the IBM z/OS environment. Software & Utilities: Proficiency with system utilities (ICKDSF, IDCAMS, IEBCOPY), and tape management systems (TLMS, RMM). Tivoli Advance catalog management (catalog management tool) and IBM Tivoli Advance allocation management for z/OS (allocation optimizer tool) Connectivity: Understanding of FICON connectivity and z/OS access methods (VSAM, QSAM). Analytical Thinking: Strong problem-solving abilities to execute complex storage migrations with minimal impact to production workloads Must have Skills Replication and PPRC protocols. Metro Mirror, Global Mirror, Global Copy Cyber - Safe Guarded Copy Experience with Copy Services Manager, ESSNI etc. Resiliency - Hyperswap & Hyperwrite Performance - Hyperlinks Nice To Have Certificate deployment and management for network connections Python or Perl Scripting GDPS Secure Vault (Cyber) - Physical and Virtual isolation. Cloud Storage for tape archival What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work. To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser. review_candidates.title: SENIOR RESEARCH ENGINEER
review_candidates.description: Senior Systems Engineering position for UAB's Engineering and Innovative Technology Development (EITD) group.Lead development of viable system requirements, track requirements and associated verification documentation, develop test plans for requirement verification activities, and provide support for flight operations for payload system for space applications.Lead development and supervise the development of detailed system engineering documents and data analysis for requirement development and verification, as well as for post-flight and pre-flight support. Review and check engineering documentation produced by others for adherence to technical specifications, quality standards, and requirements. Demonstrate effective technical communication to work closely with engineers of other disciplines to develop high reliability integrated systems. US Citizens only. Reports to EITD Systems Engineering Section Lead Duties/Responsibilities: Leads the development of systems work products based on project goals, ensuring scalability, reliability, and compliance with industry standards. Oversees engineering projects from concept to completion, ensuring adherence to timelines, budgets, and technical requirements. Conducts in-depth reviews of engineering drawings, documents, and models to validate functionality, compliance with regulations, and feasibility. Provides expert guidance to resolve complex design challenges. Engages with electrical, mechanical, software, and manufacturing teams to ensure cohesive system integration and optimal performance. Facilitates interdisciplinary problem-solving. Ensures designs adhere to industry standards, safety protocols, and governmental regulations. Oversees documentation efforts to maintain thorough records for audits and certifications. Guide and train less experienced engineers. Support meetings, teleconferences, and travel as required by projects. May be required to work nights and weekends, as necessary, to support real time flight operations.Travel to support testing and launch/return activities for approx. 7-day periods, 5-10 trips per year possible. (Annual Salary: $85,600 - $139,100) Bachelor's degree in a STEM related field and seven (7) years of related experience required. Work experience may NOT substitute for education requirement. Minimal Knowledge / Skills / Abilities: Ability to use various engineering and documentation/analysis software, MS Word, and Excel Ability to problem-solve Ability to work independently Conflict resolution skills Interpersonal skills Organizational skills Technical Communication skills (verbal & written) Prioritization skills Process improvement and quality skills Ability to train others Experience working within an industrial quality standard program Systems Engineering experience with space-flight or aerospace applications Experience with requirements development and associated verification and validation activities Preferred Knowledge / Skills / Abilities: Systems Engineering experience for development and production of embedded / integrated systems Systems Engineering experience with ISO9001 and AS9100 Quality Programs Operations support for NASA or commercial space activities Experience using CAD software (e.g. SolidEdge or SolidWorks) UAB is an Equal Employment/Equal Educational Opportunity Institution dedicated to providing equal opportunities and equal access to all individuals regardless of race, color, religion, ethnic or national origin, sex (including pregnancy), genetic information, age, disability, and veteran's status. As required by Title IX, UAB prohibits sex discrimination in any education program or activity that it operates. Individuals may report concerns or questions to UAB's Assistant Vice President and Senior Title IX Coordinator. The Title IX notice of nondiscrimination is located at uab.edu/titleix. Primary Location University Job Category Professional & Managerial Organization 440002000 Engineering & Innovative Tech Develop Employee Status Regular Shift Day/1st Shift Work Arrangement (final schedule to be determined by the department/hiring manager) Onsite

review_candidates.title: Ingénieur IVVQ Systèmes (H/F)
review_candidates.description: Descriptif du poste Notre client est un acteur majeur des hautes technologies, intervenant dans les domaines de la défense, de la sécurité, de l’aéronautique et du spatial. Dans le cadre de programmes à forts enjeux technologiques dans le secteur de la défense, nous recherchons un(e) Project Engineer / Ingénieur(e) IVVQ pour accompagner les activités d’intégration, de vérification, de validation et de qualification de systèmes complexes. Basé(e) en région parisienne, vous rejoignez une équipe pluridisciplinaire intervenant sur des projets innovants, critiques et à forte dimension système. Vous participez aux différentes phases du cycle de développement, de la définition des solutions jusqu’à leur qualification et leur mise en service. Vos défis au quotidien : Pilotage IVVQ : Définir, planifier et piloter les activités d’Intégration, Vérification, Validation et Qualification du système de combat roquette, en cohérence avec les exigences projet, les coûts et les délais. Stratégie & conformité : Participer à la définition de la stratégie IVVQ, des scénarios de tests et des plans de qualification pour le système et ses principaux sous-ensembles : munition, arme, conduite de tir, station sol, porteur et équipements partenaires. Préparation des essais : Définir les moyens d’essais nécessaires — bancs sol, moyens embarqués, environnements de simulation, HWIL/SWIL — et garantir leur disponibilité ainsi que leur bonne mise en œuvre. Conduite des campagnes d’essais : Préparer, coordonner et piloter les essais internes, industriels et externes, en lien avec les partenaires et organismes étatiques. Vous assurez également le dépouillement, l’analyse et la restitution des résultats. Sûreté & maîtrise des risques : Rédiger les plans de sécurité des essais, identifier les risques techniques et opérationnels, piloter les plans d’actions associés et veiller au respect des processus qualité et sûreté applicables. Traçabilité & reporting : Assurer la traçabilité entre les exigences, les procédures et les résultats de tests ; gérer les anomalies, contribuer aux revues techniques et rédiger les livrables de qualification. Coordination transverse : Travailler en interface étroite avec les équipes d’architecture, de développement, d’ingénierie système, de modélisation & simulation, ainsi qu’avec les responsables de livraison et les partenaires externes. Profil recherché Formation : Bac+5 / Diplôme d’Ingénieur avec une spécialisation en ingénierie système, systèmes embarqués, électronique, aéronautique, défense ou discipline équivalente. Parcours : Vous justifiez d’au moins 5 ans d’expérience en IVVQ, intégration système, qualification ou essais de systèmes complexes, idéalement dans les secteurs de la défense, de l’aéronautique ou des systèmes critiques. Expertise Technique : Expérience en IVVQ de systèmes complexes : munitions, systèmes d’armes, missiles, roquettes guidées, conduite de tir, station sol ou systèmes embarqués ; Maîtrise de la préparation, de l’exécution et du dépouillement de campagnes d’essais ; Connaissance des moyens d’essais sol et embarqués, ainsi que des environnements HWIL / SWIL ; Pratique de la rédaction de stratégies, plans, procédures et rapports de tests ; Connaissance de la sûreté de fonctionnement, de la gestion des exigences et du traitement des anomalies ; Familiarité avec les processus de développement, qualification et qualité appliqués aux environnements critiques — notamment les processus R&T et DDQS ; Des compétences en modélisation & simulation, conduite de tir ou électronique embarquée temps réel seront particulièrement appréciées Mindset : Vous êtes rigoureux(se), autonome et à l’aise dans l’analyse de problématiques techniques complexes. Vous savez prendre des décisions, fédérer des interlocuteurs variés et conserver une approche opérationnelle au plus près des essais terrain. Anglais : Vous êtes capable d’évoluer dans un environnement technique international, à l’écrit comme à l’oral. Qui sont-ils ? En entreprise, comme en musique, tout est une question de tempo. Depuis 2018, nous réunissons des consultant·e·s passionné·e·s, curieux·ses et ambitieux·ses, uni·e·s par une même conviction : mettre leur expertise au service des défis numériques, sectoriels et industriels de nos clients. Notre mission ? Accélérer les transformations en combinant excellence opérationnelle, curiosité et audace. Nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs du luxe, du retail, de l’énergie, du transport, du tourisme, de la banque ou encore de l’assurance — partout où la technologie rencontre l’humain. Nous aimons la tech quand elle connecte et libère les potentiels. Nos consultant·e·s ne se contentent pas de conseiller : ils construisent, testent, mettent en production, mesurent, ajustent et recommencent. Avec nos clients, nous faisons partie du jeu, du début à la fin . Notre organisation repose sur une culture de la confiance, de l’apprentissage et de la collaboration . Nous avons conçu un cadre unique qui accompagne chaque eXalté·e à chaque étape de sa carrière, avec des rôles clairs, des communautés actives et des rituels qui renforcent le collectif. Nos eXaltemps trimestriels, notre eXalt Academy et nos projets internes sont autant d’occasions d’apprendre, de partager et de grandir ensemble. Aujourd’hui présents en France, au Canada, aux États-Unis, au Royaume-Uni, en Belgique, en Espagne, au Portugal et à Monaco , nous sommes portés par un engagement fort et une énergie contagieuse. Parce qu’apprendre est notre discipline, agir notre obsession et réussir ensemble notre plus belle victoire. Pulse. Make. Learn. Trois mots qui rythment notre quotidien. Et peut-être bientôt le tien?

review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer, Infrastructure
review_candidates.description: About HUD HUD is building infrastructure to create RL training data and evals for frontier AI agents, as well as a marketplace to sell these to frontier labs through the HUD marketplace. Our platform is used by frontier labs, Fortune 500 companies, and startups. We’ve raised $16M from top VCs and were YC W25. About The Role We’re looking for a Platform Engineer who can own the reliability, scale, performance, and developer experience of HUD’s core infrastructure and backend systems. This is not a pure infrastructure role. The right person has strong production infra experience, but also thinks like a backend engineer: they can reason about service architecture, queues, databases, APIs, deployment safety, performance bottlenecks, and how product requirements translate into resilient systems. You’ll work across AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD, observability, and backend services to make HUD faster, more reliable, cheaper to run, and easier for engineers to build on. Responsibilities Own production uptime, latency, provisioning speed, infrastructure cost, and incident response for core platform services Build and maintain AWS infrastructure with Terraform, Kubernetes/EKS, Helm, Docker, EC2, CodeBuild, ECR, S3, IAM, networking, and secrets management Design and improve backend and platform systems for scale, including capacity planning, autoscaling, queueing, backpressure, cleanup jobs, retries, and rollback paths Define and improve dashboards, alerts, logs, traces, SLOs, runbooks, and on-call workflows so failures are detected, debugged, and resolved quickly Build reliable CI/CD, release automation, environment management, and deployment workflows that improve developer productivity and reduce production risk Write clean, maintainable code where needed to automate systems, improve backend services, and create internal tooling Experience You may be a good fit if you: Have owned production cloud infrastructure for a high-availability, user-facing platform, with responsibility for uptime, performance, deployment safety, and cost Have deep experience with AWS infrastructure and containerized systems; experience with tools like Terraform, Kubernetes/EKS, Docker, EC2, CodeBuild, ECR, S3, IAM, load balancers, networking, and secrets management is strongly preferred Have built or operated CI/CD, environment management, release automation, observability, alerting, and incident response systems Have strong backend engineering judgment and can reason about service architecture, APIs, databases, async systems, queues, scaling limits, and production failure modes Can write clean, maintainable code and apply strong software engineering judgment across product architecture, infrastructure, backend systems, and developer workflows Strong Candidates May Also Have Experience operating infrastructure for data-heavy, ML/AI, workflow, marketplace, developer-tools, or enterprise platforms Experience designing systems for bursty workloads, long-running jobs, sandboxed execution, distributed workers, or high-concurrency services Experience reducing cloud spend through better architecture, autoscaling, workload placement, caching, cleanup systems, or observability Experience building internal platforms or tools that make engineers faster without hiding too much complexity We prioritize technical aptitude, ownership, and learning potential over years of experience. Team & Company Details Team Size : ~25 people currently, mostly full-time in-person, but some remote. Our team: Our team includes 4 International Olympiad medalists (IOI, ILO, IPhO), serial AI startup founders, and researchers with publications at ICLR, NeurIPS, etc. Company stage: We have 8 figures in funding and are scaling profitably and quickly to meet very strong demand. Logistics Employment : Full-time. Location : We have offices in San Francisco or Singapore but are open to remote candidates who can work hours that 70-80% overlap with either San Francisco or Singapore time zones. Visa Sponsorship : We provide support for relocation and visas for strong full-time candidates to the US or Singapore. Timeline : Applications are rolling. The process is 2 technical interviews and a 2-3 day work trial. What we offer Competitive compensation 100% covered top-of-the-line medical, dental, and vision from Blue Shield of CA (US employees) Lunch and dinner when you’re in the office (in-office employees) Company-wide holiday break (Christmas Eve to New Year’s Day) on top of PTO and paid holidays Other perks including an Equinox membership, 401k, and commuter benefits (US employees) Unlimited* access to tokens for ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor, etc. *By unlimited, we mean no one on our token usage leaderboard has ever hit a limit. So we have no idea what the limit is. Due to high volume, we may not actively respond to every application, but feel free to contact us at [[email removed]](mailto:[email removed]) or elsewhere if we missed your application!
